description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1104: an uncaught non-Error value from a microtask gets Node 22.22.0's task_queues runMicrotasks() header when the microtasks drain in processTicksAndRejections, that is after a tick ran or was pending as the callback ended, and <anonymous_script>:0 otherwise, from -e, piped stdin and a file: a tick pending at the end of the script, a timer, an immediate, an fs and a dns callback, a tick queued from a microtask, the stdin script's own turn, and none of it leaking into a later callback; an ES module's own microtasks drain before its ticks (stderr as JSON strings)
